description: This PHP class is a test fixture used for setting up sample data related to internationalization language strings and groups within a testing environment. It fetches and formats data from I18NGroup and I18NLangString entities for use in tests.

classes.name: I18NLangStringFixture
classes.description: A test fixture class for loading sample language string data for testing purposes.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves and formats data from I18NGroup and I18NLangString entities into arrays suitable for test data loading.

methods.description: Returns the filename for the fixture data, 'LangString.yaml'.
